~ Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 2302 West Huron Street, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RT-4 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 2,942.4 square feet

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to divide the subject property from 2300 W.
Huron and develop it with a new three-story two (2) dwelling unit
residential building with a detached garage. The proposed building will
measure 37 ft.-9 inches in height. The subject property is a Transit Served
Location and will be supported by two (2) garage parking spaces at the rear.
Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and
Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is secking to increase the off-street parking
requirement for a Transit Served Location from 50% (1 parking space) to
100% (2 parking spaces) and all relief necessary, as allowed by the Chicago
Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 3,526.48 square feet (1.2 FAR) (proposed)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 1,471.2 square feet per D.U.
(2. proposed residential units)

(C)  *The amount of off-street parking: 2 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Wester Bus
Route). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to increase the
off-street parking requirement from 50% (1 parking space) to 100% (2 parking
spaces).

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 8 feet-7.88 inches
b. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 2 feet
East Side: 3 feet-2 inches

c. Rear Setback: 36 feet-9.38 inches

) Building Height: 37 feet-9 inches
